class.name: EretheaPostEffect
class.brief_description: Lens and film effects: vignette, chromatic aberration and film grain.
class.description: A [CompositorEffect] that adds lens and film effects to a 3D view. Add it to a [Compositor] and set that compositor on a [WorldEnvironment] or a [Camera3D]: [codeblock] var effect = EretheaPostEffect.new() effect.vignette_intensity = 0.4 effect.film_grain_intensity = 0.2 var compositor = Compositor.new() compositor.compositor_effects = [effect] $WorldEnvironment.compositor = compositor [/codeblock] Every effect starts off. The effects are drawn on the scene's linear colors after the transparent pass, before temporal antialiasing, upscaling and tone mapping. With [member Viewport.use_taa] or FSR 2, the film grain also goes through the temporal accumulation, which can soften it. [b]Note:[/b] This effect needs the Forward+ renderer. With the Mobile and Compatibility renderers it does nothing. [b]Note:[/b] [member CompositorEffect.effect_callback_type] and the buffer settings of [CompositorEffect] don't apply to this effect, which always runs after the transparent pass.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one effect is on. When none is, the effect costs nothing.

members.member: How far apart the red and blue channels are pushed towards the edges of the screen, like a lens that bends colors differently. At [code]1.0[/code], they are 1% of the screen width apart in the corners. [code]0.0[/code] turns it off.

Strength of the film grain, a noise that changes every frame. It is applied as a relative change of the scene's colors, so it doesn't depend on exposure, and it fades out in highlights after tone mapping, like film. [code]0.0[/code] turns it off.
Size of the grain, in pixels of the 3D view (before upscaling).
How much the corners of the screen are darkened. At [code]1.0[/code], the corners are black. [code]0.0[/code] turns it off.
How far towards the center the vignette fades in, from the corners. At [code]1.0[/code], it starts darkening at the center of the screen; lower values keep it closer to the corners.
